summary: I'll find and fix the bug that makes adding a new menu item fail with a 'Bad Request' error, so you can build out your menu again.

personas.label: Shop owner
personas.description: Signs in with an emailed link and manages the menu, settings and incoming orders.

stories.goal: Add a new item to the menu from /manage/menu and have it save
acceptance: Owner fills in a new item's name, description, price and category on /manage/menu and taps Save, and the item appears in the menu list with no error banner
The new item shows on the public menu once marked available

stories.goal: Edit an existing menu item's price or description and have the change save
acceptance: Owner changes an existing item's price on /manage/menu and taps Save, and the list shows the new price with no error banner

entities.name: MenuItem
entities.description: An existing menu item (name, description, price, category); this fix does not add or change its fields.

outOfScope: Fixing the separate report that order status buttons (Mark preparing, Mark ready, Cancel) also return a Bad Request error on /manage/orders — not part of this request
Fixing the separate report that seeded demo orders show £0.00 per line in the order queue
Fixing the separate report that new orders do not appear on /manage/orders without a page reload
Changing the 'Estimated ready' wording on the order confirmation page
assumptions: Earlier testing found that every save on the menu editor (both adding and editing items) fails the same way — a 'Bad Request' error with nothing saved — while shop settings save correctly. This points to one shared fault in how the menu editor's saves are handled, so this fix covers adding new items (what you reported) and editing existing ones (the same fault, found during earlier testing), since fixing only one would leave the other broken.

Two other write actions — advancing or cancelling an order's status on /manage/orders — were separately found broken with the same kind of error. They are a different screen and are not part of what you asked me to fix here; I've left them out of scope so you can confirm whether you want those fixed next.
